name: web-dark-bento-feature-cards-with-fingerprint-ring-and-noise-graph
title: Five dark bordered feature cards: '100% Customizable' with an oval scribble, a fingerprint, a speed waveform, a growth chart and an avatar list
whatItIs: A black page with a bento of hairline-bordered cards: '100% Customizable' inside a scribbled white oval, a fingerprint icon in a circle with 'Secure by default', a download speed waveform with 'Faster than light', a wide card with a rising jagged white line chart in a mini window, and a card with floating name tags and avatars for 'Keep your loved ones safe'.
whatItMeans: Minimal and technical; thin lines and small illustrations feel like a modern dev-tool.
techniques: Border cards with hairlines on black.
Circle a key number with a scribbled oval.
Illustrate each feature with a tiny graphic.

vocabulary.definition: A card with a thin subtle border.
A hand-drawn ring around a word.
A chart inside a tiny browser frame.
A small image explaining one feature.
